faculty.name: Osama Ahmed
faculty.summary: Studies the robustness of biological neural networks, using fruit flies as a model organism.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究生物神经网络的鲁棒性，使用果蝇作为模型生物。

faculty.name: Geoffrey Boynton
faculty.summary: Studies the relationship between neuronal responses in the visual cortex and conscious visual experience, focusing on attention and perceptual tasks.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉皮层神经反应与意识视觉体验之间的关系，重点关注注意力和感知任务。

faculty.name: Jonathon Brown
faculty.summary: Studies the development and impact of self-esteem on emotional reactions to success and failure, focusing on cultural similarities and differences.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自尊的发展及其对成功和失败的情绪反应的影响，重点关注文化相似性和差异性。

faculty.name: Sapna Cheryan
faculty.summary: Studies how cultural stereotypes affect racial and gender diversity in computer science and the health consequences of identity recognition, using lab-based research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究文化刻板印象如何影响计算机科学领域的种族和性别多样性以及身份认同被认可的健康后果，采用实验室研究方法。

faculty.name: Cyril Delgado
faculty.summary: Manages academic services for psychology students and faculty.
faculty.summary_zh: 管理心理学系学生的学业服务。

faculty.name: Shannon Dorsey
faculty.summary: Studies treatment effectiveness and implementation science for mental health care in low and under-resourced settings, training lay counselors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究低资源地区儿童和青少年的心理健康治疗方法的有效性和实施科学，培训非专业治疗师。

faculty.name: Angela Fang
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiological mechanisms of social information processing in social anxiety disorder and body dysmorphic disorder, using brain connectivity techniques and pharmacologic administration.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社交焦虑障碍和躯体变形障碍中社会信息处理的神经生物学机制，使用脑连接技术及药物干预方法。

faculty.name: Ione Fine
faculty.summary: Studies the computational and neurophysiological basis of visual processing, including perceptual learning and retinal prostheses.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉处理的计算和神经生理基础，包括知觉学习和视网膜假体。

faculty.name: Brian Flaherty
faculty.summary: Studies measurement and applied statistics with a developmental perspective, focusing on latent variable models and the analysis of change.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究测量和应用统计，具有发展视角，专注于潜在变量模型和变化分析。

faculty.name: Jennifer Forsyth
faculty.summary: Studies the genetic and environmental factors contributing to the emergence of psychotic symptoms in adolescence, using genetic, neuroimaging, and behavioral methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青春期精神病症状出现的遗传和环境因素，使用遗传学、神经成像和行为学方法。

faculty.name: Katherine T. Foster
faculty.summary: Studies individual differences in psychopathology and health behaviors over the lifespan, using person-centered approaches and longitudinal methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究心理障碍和健康行为在个体和生命周期中的差异，采用个体中心的方法和纵向研究方法。

faculty.name: William George
faculty.summary: Studies the influence of alcohol on sexual behavior, including sexual aggression and HIV risk-taking, using experimental designs and individual differences.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究酒精对性行为的影响，包括性侵犯和HIV风险行为，使用实验设计和个体差异评估。

faculty.name: David Gire
faculty.summary: Studies how brains code and respond to sensory inputs during active behavior, using electrophysiology and optogenetics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑在主动行为中如何编码和响应感官输入，使用电生理学和光遗传学技术。

faculty.name: Debrielle T. Jacques
faculty.summary: Studies how parent and family factors affect caregiving, family functioning, and children's psychological development and risk for psychopathology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究父母和家庭因素如何影响照顾、家庭功能以及儿童的心理发展和心理病理风险。

faculty.name: Peter Kahn
faculty.summary: Studies the psychological impacts of human interaction with nature and technological systems, including the effects on children's development and the design of personified computational systems.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类与自然和技术系统互动的心理影响，包括对儿童发展的影响以及人形计算系统的设计。

faculty.name: Cheryl Kaiser
faculty.summary: Studies psychological aspects of prejudice, stereotypes, and diversity, and their intersection with law, politics, and policy.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究偏见、刻板印象和多样性等心理方面及其与法律、政治和政策的交叉。

faculty.name: Jeansok Kim
faculty.summary: Studies fear and stress responses in rats and Alzheimer’s disease models, using optogenetics and electrophysiology to examine neural circuit dynamics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究恐惧和压力反应在大鼠和阿尔茨海默病模型中的神经环路动态，使用光遗传学和电生理学方法。

faculty.name: Kevin King
faculty.summary: Studies how cognitive and emotional self-regulation develops in adolescence, using advanced statistical methods to examine substance use risk factors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青春期认知和情绪自我调节的发展，使用高级统计方法探讨物质使用风险因素。

faculty.name: Mary Larimer
faculty.summary: Studies prevention and treatment of alcohol and substance use disorders among adolescents and young adults, predicting initiation and maintenance of risky drinking patterns, and co-morbidity with.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青少年和年轻成人酒精和物质使用障碍的预防和治疗方法，预测风险饮酒模式的形成和维持，以及与抑郁、焦虑和赌博障碍的共病。

faculty.name: Liliana Lengua
faculty.summary: Studies children's emotional, social and behavioral adjustment, focusing on individual differences in response to adversity and vulnerability/resilience.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童的情绪、社会和行为调整，重点关注在逆境中个体差异的反应、脆弱性和韧性。

faculty.name: Cynthia Levine
faculty.summary: Studies how cultural, social, and psychological factors influence health and well-being, focusing on the fit between individuals and their social contexts.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究文化、社会和心理因素如何影响健康和福祉，重点关注个体与其社会环境的契合度。

faculty.name: Priscilla Lui
faculty.summary: Studies the impact of cultural, ethnic, and racial experiences on psychopathology and addictive behaviors, developing measurement tools and interventions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究文化、种族和 Ethnicity 经验对心理病理学和成瘾行为的影响，开发测量工具和干预措施。

faculty.name: Lucía Magis-Weinberg
faculty.summary: Studies how digital technologies impact adolescent development, focusing on social and affective tasks in international settings.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究数字技术如何影响青少年发展，特别是在国际背景下对社交和情感任务的影响。

faculty.name: Andrew Meltzoff
faculty.summary: Studies how infants develop understanding of others, focusing on imitation, memory, and social-cognitive development, linking to neuroscience measures.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何理解他人，重点在于模仿、记忆和社会认知发展，并将其与神经科学指标联系起来。

faculty.name: Scott Murray
faculty.summary: Studies the neural and computational mechanisms of perception and attention, using fMRI, computational models, and behavioral assessments, with a focus on neurodiversity, particularly autism.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究知觉和注意力的神经和计算机制，使用功能性磁共振成像、计算模型和行为评估方法，特别关注神经多样性，包括自闭症。

faculty.name: Chantel Prat
faculty.summary: Studies individual differences in complex skill learning like reading and programming using fMRI, EEG, and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究复杂技能学习（如阅读和编程）中的个体差异，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、脑电图（EEG）和行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Betty Repacholi
faculty.summary: Studies how infants understand and learn from emotional expressions, using attentional cues and socially-guided learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何理解并从情感表达中学习，使用注意力线索和社会导向学习的方法。

faculty.name: Yuichi Shoda
faculty.summary: Studies individual differences in psychological responses to social situations, using quantitative methods to identify triggers of specific behaviors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究个体在社会情境中的心理反应差异，使用定量方法识别特定行为的触发因素。

faculty.name: Joseph Sisneros
faculty.summary: Studies how fish auditory systems adapt to social and reproductive signals, using behavioral and neurophysiological methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究鱼类听觉系统如何适应社会和繁殖信号，使用行为和神经生理学方法。

faculty.name: Ariel Starr
faculty.summary: Studies how language interacts with memory and numerical cognition in children’s development using behavioral and eye-tracking methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言如何与儿童记忆和数理认知相互作用，使用行为和追踪凝视方法。

faculty.name: Andrea Stocco
faculty.summary: Studies the computational processes in the brain, focusing on the prefrontal cortex and basal ganglia interactions for intelligent behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑中的计算过程，特别是前额叶皮层和基底节之间的交互作用，以实现智能行为。

faculty.name: Z Yan Wang
faculty.summary: Studies the neuroethology of corpse-directed behavior in bees and the nervous system of cephalopods, focusing on oddities and death spirals.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究蜜蜂的尸体定向行为和乌贼的神经系统，关注异常现象和死亡螺旋。

faculty.name: Jhada Weems
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and development in children, using behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知过程和发展，使用行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Clara Wilkins
faculty.summary: Studies how social hierarchies and perceptions of bias affect intergroup relations and discrimination, using psychological experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会等级制度和偏见感知如何影响群体关系和歧视，使用心理实验方法。

faculty.name: Amber Williams
faculty.summary: Studies how children think about racial and ethnic categories, stereotypes, and inequality, and how these beliefs impact their behaviors and attitudes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童对种族和 Ethnic 类别、刻板印象和不平等的看法，以及这些信念如何影响他们的行为和态度。

faculty.name: Lori Zoellner
faculty.summary: Studies mechanisms of trauma memory and recovery, focusing on prevention and intervention strategies to reduce chronic psychopathology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究创伤记忆和恢复机制，重点在于预防和干预策略，以减少慢性心理病理学。

faculty.name: Ellen Covey
faculty.summary: Studies how complex sound patterns are processed in the auditory brainstem of bats and humans, using neuropharmacological experiments and electrophysiological recordings.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究哺乳动物听觉脑干中复杂声模式的处理机制，使用神经药理学实验和电生理记录方法。

faculty.name: Sheri Mizumori
faculty.summary: Studies neuroplasticity mechanisms of learning, memory, and decision-making using rodent models and optogenetic techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习、记忆和决策的神经可塑性机制，使用啮齿动物模型和光遗传学技术。

faculty.name: Kyrill Gurtovenko
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural correlates using computational models and neuroimaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，使用计算模型和神经成像技术。

faculty.name: Neil Kirkpatrick
faculty.summary: Directs a parenting clinic, focusing on parent-child interactions and child development.
faculty.summary_zh: 指导育儿诊所，专注于亲子互动和儿童发展。

faculty.name: Douglas Ramsay
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes in children, focusing on learning and development.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童的认知过程，重点在于学习和发育。

faculty.name: Sara Jane Webb
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, focusing on memory and attention.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注记忆和注意力。

faculty.name: Sama Ahmed
faculty.summary: Studies motivation, emotion, and motor function, examining sensory perception and motor control in students.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动机、情绪和运动功能，探讨感觉感知和运动控制，面向学生。

faculty.name: Michael Ailion
faculty.summary: Studies cellular and molecular neuroscience, focusing on motivation-emotion-state and sensory function & perception.
faculty.summary_zh: 从事细胞与分子神经科学研究，关注动机-情绪-状态以及感觉功能与感知。

faculty.name: Fritzie Arce-McShane
faculty.summary: Studies motor and sensory functions using systems neuroscience approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究运动和感觉功能，采用系统神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Chip Asbury
faculty.summary: Studies cellular and molecular neuroscience, focusing on the mechanisms of neural signaling and development.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究细胞和分子神经科学，专注于神经信号传导和发育机制。

faculty.name: Nathan Baertsch
faculty.summary: Studies motivation, emotion, and motor function using systems neuroscience approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动机、情绪和运动功能的认知神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Wyeth Bair
faculty.summary: Studies computational and systems neuroscience, focusing on theoretical approaches to understanding brain function.
faculty.summary_zh: 从事计算和系统神经科学的研究，侧重于理论方法来理解大脑功能。

faculty.name: Melissa Barker-Haliski
faculty.summary: Studies disorders of the nervous system at the cellular and molecular level.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经系统疾病的细胞和分子机制。

faculty.name: Andres Barria
faculty.summary: Studies cellular and molecular neuroscience, focusing on mechanisms at the cellular level.
faculty.summary_zh: 从事细胞与分子神经科学研究，关注细胞机制。

faculty.name: Michele Basso
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive function and motor and sensory processing using computational and systems neuroscience approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知功能以及运动和感觉处理，采用计算和系统神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Martha Bos
faculty.summary: Studies the development of the nervous system at the cellular and molecular level.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经系统发育的细胞和分子机制。

faculty.name: Michael Bruchas
faculty.summary: Studies the cellular and molecular mechanisms of motivation and emotion in the brain, using systems neuroscience approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑中动机和情绪的细胞和分子机制，采用系统神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Bing Brunton
faculty.summary: Studies computational and systems neuroscience, focusing on theoretical approaches to understanding brain function.
faculty.summary_zh: 从事计算和系统神经科学的研究，侧重于理论方法来理解大脑功能。

faculty.name: Astra Bryant
faculty.summary: Studies cellular and molecular mechanisms of sensory function and perception, using systems neuroscience approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究感觉功能和知觉的细胞和分子机制，采用系统神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Elizabeth Buffalo
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive function and disorders of the nervous system using systems neuroscience approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知功能和神经系统疾病，采用系统神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Clemens Cabernard
faculty.summary: Studies the development of the nervous system at the cellular and molecular level.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经系统发育的细胞和分子机制。

faculty.name: Erik Carlson
faculty.summary: Studies disorders of the nervous system using systems neuroscience approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经系统疾病，采用系统神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Charles Chavkin
faculty.summary: Studies cellular and molecular mechanisms of motivation and emotion in animals.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动机和情绪的细胞和分子机制，使用动物模型。

faculty.name: Timothy Cherry
faculty.summary: Studies the development of the nervous system and disorders affecting it, focusing on sensory function and perception.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经系统的发展及其疾病，重点关注感觉功能和感知。

faculty.name: Gabriel Cler
faculty.summary: Studies disorders of the nervous system and motor function, accepting rotation students.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经系统疾病和运动功能障碍，接受研究生申请。

faculty.name: Kevin Coffey
faculty.summary: Studies disorders of the nervous system and motivation-emotion-state relationships, accepting rotation students.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经系统疾病和动机-情绪-状态关系，接受研究生轮转学生。

faculty.name: Forrest Collman
faculty.summary: Studies cellular and molecular neuroscience and computational/theoretical neuroscience.
faculty.summary_zh: 从事细胞与分子神经科学和计算/理论神经科学研究。

faculty.name: Valerie Daggett
faculty.summary: Studies cellular and molecular mechanisms of nervous system disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经系统疾病中的细胞和分子机制。

faculty.name: Kayvon Daie
faculty.summary: Studies computational and theoretical aspects of motor function and systems neuroscience.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究计算和理论神经科学中的运动功能和系统神经科学。

faculty.name: Martin Darvas
faculty.summary: Studies cellular and molecular mechanisms of nervous system disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经系统疾病中的细胞和分子机制。

faculty.name: Nikolai Dembrow
faculty.summary: Studies cellular and molecular mechanisms of motor function using computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究运动功能的细胞和分子机制，使用计算模型。

faculty.name: Ajay Dhaka
faculty.summary: Studies cellular and molecular mechanisms of sensory function and perception.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究感觉功能和感知的细胞和分子机制。

faculty.name: Adrienne Fairhall
faculty.summary: Studies computational and theoretical neuroscience, using mathematical models to understand brain function.
faculty.summary_zh: 从事计算和理论神经科学的研究，使用数学模型来理解大脑功能。

faculty.name: Yijie Geng
faculty.summary: Studies the development of the nervous system and disorders of the nervous system, focusing on motivation-emotion-state and systems neuroscience.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经系统的发展和神经系统障碍，重点关注动机-情绪-状态和系统神经科学。

faculty.name: Anna Gillespie
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive function and disorders of the nervous system using systems neuroscience approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知功能和神经系统疾病，采用系统神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Sam Golden
faculty.summary: Studies disorders of the nervous system, focusing on motivation-emotion-state and systems neuroscience.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经系统疾病，侧重动机-情绪-状态以及系统神经科学。

faculty.name: Matt Golub
faculty.summary: Studies computational and theoretical neuroscience.
faculty.summary_zh: 从事计算和理论神经科学的研究。
